verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed an llms.txt file served at developer.productboard.com/llms.txt. It states that appending .md to any documentation page URL returns a markdown version, and many developer reference pages are cited in .md form, including MCP install and getting-started pages. missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt covers product/help documentation beyond the Public API reference, and any llms-full.txt or independent corroboration of agent usability.
